review_mode: Fresh full framework-wide embedding compatibility design/source-feasibility review. First inspect current pool/backward-compatibility amendment, then the complete embedding-affecting REM/companion contracts and ALL maintained direct/indirect consumers, named or unnamed. Not implementation conformance.
source_pin_scope: Seed locations only. This is NOT a closed review inventory. Search all packages/*/src and maintained entrypoints/scripts and inspect tests/config fixtures for transitive consumers, constants and contracts. All tracked files are frozen by manifest.

acceptance_criteria.EC-01: Exact authority, frozen revision, read-only scope and model-change/fresh-namespace boundary; explicit current request supersedes the completed prior round budget only for this one review.
acceptance_criteria.EC-02: Independent framework-wide source inventory, not limited to REM named paths. Discover direct embedding calls, provided/cached vectors, indirect storage/comparisons and affected shared contracts; include unlisted subsystems or source-backed unaffected dispositions.
acceptance_criteria.EC-03: Unchanged pre-existing catalog/pool and maintained non-pool configuration preserves default/explicit service, profile, endpoint/credential, batch/cache/resilience selection; no silent rebinding or ingestion-only model selector.
acceptance_criteria.EC-04: Existing embedding API/protocol callers remain compatible; every necessary store/query-envelope extension has actual downstream consumers classified, narrow allowed paths and regression obligations, including previously unnamed ones.
acceptance_criteria.EC-05: Optional new YAML capability fields resolve from qualified exact-identity readiness without mandatory config rewrites. Missing baseline qualification is a readiness stop; parse-only success, guessed metadata, disabled used services or an unguarded lane cannot count as compatibility.
acceptance_criteria.EC-06: Shared LLM owns exact preparation/counting/request/result validation, Memory owns namespace admission; all document/query roles and caches correct, no subsystem-specific duplicate guard and no asymmetric formatting with unknown caller.
acceptance_criteria.EC-07: Graph creation/update/backfill/scoring, node/edge cached vectors, on-demand fallback and shared recall query have compatible identity/roles. No silent zero-score/empty-result degradation for incompatible vectors.
acceptance_criteria.EC-08: Conversation extraction separates extraction LLM selection from embedding service; graph edges and stored insights/summaries retain correct binding and typed failure behavior. Full extraction-to-store-to-recall compatibility proof specified.
acceptance_criteria.EC-09: Maintenance synthesis/re-embedding and stored-vector pruning/clustering/verification-related clients are classified; distinct maintenance binding cannot write an incompatible space, and direct clients/snapshot/restore/rollback preserve identity.
acceptance_criteria.EC-10: Lifecycle promotion/decay/reactivation, compaction and indirect derived-record/tool/source storage are covered. Document/512 applies only to ingestion planning; no silent re-chunking of structured memory records.
acceptance_criteria.EC-11: Runtime/Core/CLI/Chat plus every other maintained package/entrypoint are assessed for direct or transitive effects. Non-embedding operations, LLM-only services, tool registration, startup/background/exit and optional-dependency behavior do not acquire unexplained new failure modes. Distinguish actual wiring, public-unwired and inactive/example code.
acceptance_criteria.EC-12: Replacement model tests cover changed dimension and same-dimension different space/preparation. Fresh coherent vector/graph/WAL and relevant recovery/cache roots are explicit. Fresh data assumption does not excuse API/configuration/role/hard-coded dimension regressions or authorize deleting/migrating personal stores.
acceptance_criteria.EC-13: Separate names/timeouts may share one compatible namespace; independently bound namespaces may legitimately use different models. One namespace cannot mix vectors, and a failure in an unrelated unused pool service does not disable a qualified operation.
acceptance_criteria.EC-14: Effective capacity, overflow and full result/index/dimension/finite validation guard every embedding path and cache, with actionable typed propagation and no silent partial-success/error-swallowing loopholes.
acceptance_criteria.EC-15: DI-18/21/22/27-33 and Gate-A inventory are sufficient or identify exact gaps. Require unchanged fixture and replacement-model cross-subsystem positive/negative and normal/optimized installed proof before implementation acceptance; do not demand execution of future Gate-A/model/build tests in this design review.
acceptance_criteria.EC-16: Newly identified affected consumers fit an explicit narrow allowed purpose or are a mandatory document-scope/test gap. No implicit permission for broad subsystem rewrites, automatic routing, model migrations, TUI or maintenance-order redesign.
acceptance_criteria.EC-17: Retained extraction/Tools companion and security/dependency/Certifi constraints remain coherent with framework compatibility; no default dependency/schema/resource change silently breaks unlisted consumers or optional/minimal installations. Pending measured dependency feasibility remains Gate-A, not an invented implementation pass.
acceptance_criteria.EC-18: Current review state and exact pins are coherent, historical verdicts are not reused as proof, findings and evidence limitations are precise, and report contains complete independent consumer and two-scenario compatibility matrices with honest scores.

score_rule: Return honest independent /10 and exactly VERIFIED, CHANGES_REQUESTED or BLOCKED for design readiness. The controller retains each-seat >=9.5/no mandatory findings as target; never adjust a score toward it. No runtime assurance or implementation acceptance follows.

conduct.freshness: Fresh context, no parent transcript/private reasoning or current peer verdicts. No prior raw council reports, historical peer report text, nested agents or repairs. Historical scores in current status docs are permitted history only, not evidence or isolation failure by themselves.
conduct.shared_checkout_exception: Explicit bounded shared-checkout READ-ONLY review with private external scratch and start/end frozen checks. Never write/stage/commit/checkout/clean shared repository or supplied inputs. T3 host may write checkpoint refs/objects; logical index, HEAD, status and protected files must still match.
conduct.outputs: All reports/audits/cache/temp/export outputs in YOUR OWN fresh external scratch. Verify supplied helper/wrapper hash and inspect them. Never replay historical receipt argv or output paths. Do not write the supplied input directory or other reviewers/builder scratch.
conduct.commands: ALL Git/admin commands and any child process invoking Git/admin go through python3 -B INPUTS/read_only_command.py OWN_SCRATCH -- ARGV. It forces GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and private caches. Plain static source/input/scratch reads, ast/text inspection, own report writes and own hashes are exempt; use Python -B. No unwrapped Git/admin. This is audit discipline, not an OS sandbox.
conduct.diffs: Use ONLY explicit technical/status paths for amendment/diff inspection; never an unfiltered aggregate/history diff that exposes raw peer reviews. Read current authority.json only by extracting document_ingestion_remediation current controls/current_revision plus active_council_roster, branch/current_scope/product_code_authority; do not dump other-unit history or old council_history/results.
conduct.private_state: Do not inspect/list/read personal stores, .friday-old, exports or dirty example YAML as evidence. Integrity helper alone may hash protected files/stat six records. Use committed packaged config templates or committed historical examples via wrapped Git for fixture/schema analysis; no secret output.
conduct.effects: No product imports, runtime tests/builds, dependency resolution/install/model download, application/model/provider calls, real store operations, reset/migration/re-embedding or repository/PR mutation. Read-only official public primary documentation is allowed if useful; no live application credentials. Static tests/source reading and deterministic document calculations are allowed.
conduct.violations: Shared/input write or isolation breach is BLOCKED and disclosed; never cleanup/restore away. An unwrapped Git/admin invocation with unestablished guard is BLOCKED. Do not misclassify exempt cat/rg/pathlib/own-report reads as violations.
conduct.closing: Run final integrity after the last shared inspection. Afterwards private scratch/report/hash activity is allowed; any further shared/Git/admin inspection requires repeating closing integrity.

required_checks.command: First verify request SHA and helper/wrapper hashes; run helper through wrapper into OWN/start-integrity.json. Logical index must be measured before status.

Independently discover source-backed direct/indirect consumers throughout the framework, including unnamed subsystems. Assess all EC-01..18, both unchanged configuration and model replacement/fresh namespace. Produce full consumer/disposition and two-scenario matrix; inspect relevant tests and missing proposed proofs. This is not a future runtime test run.
Repeat exact immutable helper through wrapper after final shared inspection; all pins, logical index/status and six metadata records match.

known_limits: The REM is proposed, source is unchanged since the prior MAINT product baseline; missing implementation is not this design gate failure.
Gate-A exact model/dependency/counter and actual normal/optimized installed proofs are future obligations, not performed here.

Historical root Ruff534, root collection test_display conflict7196, legacy formatting and MAINT oracle debt remain failed/unwaived background; no whole-repository-green claim or runtime reruns requested.

Explicit fresh compatible namespace after an embedding-space change is assumed operator action in future; user did not authorize deletion/reset/migration in this review. No need to design a general migration framework.
report: Write OWN_SCRATCH/review-report.md: exact verdict, score with rubric, candidate/authority/independence, source-backed full consumer matrix INCLUDING newly found unnamed consumers and unaffected dispositions, baseline-config and replacement-model scenario matrix, all18 criteria, stable seat-prefixed mandatory/advisory findings with precise document/source path/line, required narrow mitigation and tests, exact admin commands/exits, reproduced vs inspected/future obligations, start/end audit/private isolation and limits. Finish with full report path and SHA256. No pressure to declare runtime compatibility; identify concrete contract/allowlist/test omissions instead of demanding unapproved implementation now.
iteration: One newly authorized pass only. No nested review, retry/replacement or automatic remediation loop.
